newsitem.title: LATVIA: WATCHDOG SAYS ONE BROKERS' ASSOCIATION NEEDED.
newsitem.headline: WATCHDOG SAYS ONE BROKERS' ASSOCIATION NEEDED.

text.p: The Latvian securities commission (LSC) on Friday called for an association joining all the country's market players, around 600 to 700 in total, to be formed.
No brokers' organisation has been registered in the companies' register yet but two initiative groups are currently at work to form an association.
"There is a lack of a brokers' association...and the commission is now trying to enhance the process," Viktors Gustsons, the chairman of the LSC, told a news conference.
"We would like to see one association, not two," he added.
"It is an accepted practice for a state watchdog to delegate certain functions to a brokers' association," Gustsons added.
